definitions.gloss: repeating a year, being held back
definitions.explanation: Having to repeat the same grade or year in school due to failing to meet academic requirements or attendance.

examples.japanese: {単位|たんい}が{足|た}りなくて{留年|りゅうねん}した。
examples.english: I had to repeat a year because I didn't have enough credits.

examples.japanese: {留年|りゅうねん}を{避|さ}けるために{必死|ひっし}で{勉強|べんきょう}した。
examples.english: I studied desperately to avoid repeating a year.

examples.japanese: {出席|しゅっせき}{日数|にっすう}が{足|た}りなくて、{留年|りゅうねん}が{決|き}まってしまった。
examples.english: I didn't have enough attendance days, so it was decided that I would repeat the year.

notes:
{留年|りゅうねん} means repeating a school year due to insufficient credits or attendance. It can happen at any educational level but is most commonly discussed in the context of university.

WORD FORMATION:
{留|りゅう} (stay, remain) + {年|ねん} (year).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {留年|りゅうねん}する: to repeat a year
- {留年|りゅうねん}が{決|き}まる: to be confirmed that one will repeat
- {留年|りゅうねん}を{避|さ}ける: to avoid repeating a year
- {留年|りゅうねん}が{決|き}まってしまった: it was decided I'd be held back

COMMON CAUSES:
- {単位|たんい}が{足|た}りない: not enough credits
- {出席|しゅっせき}{日数|にっすう}が{足|た}りない: not enough attendance days

RELATED TERMS:
- {進級|しんきゅう}: advancing to the next grade (opposite)
- {落第|らくだい}: failing, flunking
- {休学|きゅうがく}: taking leave from school
